message.reasoning_content: I need to draft an email, but there's no email address for Dr. Noura in the vault, and I also can't actually send emails since I only have file tools available. So I'll ask the user for her email address and clarify how they'd like to proceed — I can compose the email for them, but I won't be able to send it directly.

function.name: user_input
function.arguments: {"question":"I can draft the email, but I have no email-sending tool and I don't have Dr. Noura's address in your notes. What's her email, and do you want me to save the draft in the project folder for you to send yourself (or paste into an email tool)?"}
